authorizedRoute.routeType: public first-party Music Department email for music submissions, with a consolidated physical-delivery alternative
authorizedRoute.contactPublication: KVRX publishes both addresses in plaintext on its official Contact page. It instructs artists to send all music submissions for airplay consideration to music@kvrx.org and reserves operations@kvrx.org for questions about submissions.
authorizedRoute.explicitPurpose: Direct music submission for airplay consideration through the Music Department mailbox; the Operations mailbox is informational only and is not a second delivery route.
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Confirm that the selected track contains no AI-assisted or AI-generated music, verify current digital delivery specifications, and then use the Music Department route once. Use Operations only for an asset-free process question if specifications cannot be confirmed.

emails.role: Music Department and canonical music-submission destination
emails.verification: Published in plaintext on KVRX's official Contact page, repeated under Music Department, and explicitly designated for all music submissions for airplay consideration. The address has valid syntax and exactly matches the official kvrx.org domain.

emails.role: questions about music submissions; not a music-delivery destination
emails.verification: Published in plaintext on the same first-party page specifically for inquiries or questions regarding music submissions. It is retained as an informational contact and is not counted as a second submission opportunity.

businessContact.emailStatus: one source-verified direct Music Department submission mailbox plus one source-verified informational mailbox
businessContact.verification: Verification was limited to first-party publication, syntax, exact domain alignment, stated role and current official-site availability. No address was guessed or obtained from a third-party directory. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: KVRX authorizes email and physical submissions but does not publish complete digital delivery specifications. A human must confirm provenance and technical requirements before supplying music.
adjacentRoutesExcluded: duplicate simultaneous use of digital and physical delivery

activityVerification.evidence: KVRX's official homepage exposed a functioning live now-playing interface; the official schedule contained Spring 2026, Sprinterim 2026 and senior-sign-off blocks with freeform and specialty programming; and the official blog contained current station and music coverage dated through June 2, 2026.

genreFitEvidence: KVRX identifies its programming as freeform and specialty radio under the slogan None of the Hits, All of the Time.
Its official album-review taxonomy includes Hip Hop / Rap and World / Reggae categories.

Selected non-AI-assisted MarcsMusic electronic, experimental, hip-hop-adjacent, reggae, world-fusion or cross-genre releases have plausible programming fit, subject to human track selection and provenance review.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: KVRX provides an explicit direct submission destination and currently accepts digital and physical music, but its published policy rejects AI-assisted/generated music and omits technical delivery specifications, international eligibility and content rules. Human review is mandatory to verify track provenance, obtain current format instructions and prevent duplicate or misrouted delivery.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code search was performed for KVRX and music@kvrx.org before creation. No previous music-submission-agent platform, runtime seed, business-contact or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The Music Department email and physical alternative are stored once as one canonical opportunity. The Operations mailbox is informational only. Programming, booking, production, newsletter, login, staff and social routes are excluded as duplicate or unauthorized substitutes.

notes: One new free-first KVRX submission opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. The direct Music Department mailbox and separate questions mailbox were source-verified. The published AI restriction is a hard eligibility gate. No email, music, form, physical package or payment action occurred.
